Add or rename a doc, then fix its one line below in the same PR and run make hub (ingestion/build_hub_page.py), which writes the web copy (app/hub.html, live at abov.github.io/courtconnect-ca/hub.html). ci/check_docs_hub.py fails CI if a doc in docs/ is missing here, a link is broken or the web copy is stale.

2. Start here

New to the project? Read these in order.

  1. ../README.md: what it is, quick start, how to edit the data. Then case_study.md: the story in one read.
  2. Understand the build: architecture.md, data_guide.md, the decision records.
  3. Change something: seeds under transform/seeds/, then make build and make app-data (data_guide.md; ../CONTRIBUTING.md for reports and PRs).
  4. Reuse it elsewhere: fork_guide.md. Add a state or country: new_region_checklist.md.
  5. What is being worked on now: status.md.

5. Every doc, by purpose

The full list. Docs open on GitHub.

Understand it

  • case_study.md: the problem, trade-offs and incidents.
  • architecture.md (with architecture.svg): layers and flow.
  • tools_and_strategies.md: tools, sources, governance, ML, CI.
  • data_guide.md: sources, seeds and how to edit them.
  • scale.md: what the extracts read of Overture, and how build time grows with data.
  • running_costs.md: hosting, data, CI and the capped AI agents.
  • talk_outline.md, articles/: walkthrough outline and write-ups.

Product, market and plans

  • product_brief.md, value_proposition.md: who it is for and why each piece exists.
  • competitor_scan.md, market_insights.md, search_interest_plan.md, sport_directories.md: who else is out there and where demand is.
  • monetization_ideas.md, email_provider_comparison.md: after-beta ideas (ideas only).
  • status.md: priorities and dated detail. History: archive/session_digest.md.
  • Feature plans: player_finding_plan.md, sport_discovery_plan.md, sport_recommendation_plan.md, racket_vacations_plan.md, court_usage_plan.md, walls_into_venues_plan.md, community_reports_plan.md, self_service_plan.md, recheck_queue_plan.md.
  • Ask box: chatbot.md (plan, test questions, UX todo).
  • Beta and UX: feedback.md (round plan and findings), ux_polish.md.

Data quality and monitoring

  • data_quality.md: scorecard and SLAs. coverage_snapshot.md: generated by make report.
  • data_observability.md: Elementary pipeline health. ops_metrics.md: delivery and workflow metrics. agent_activity.md: live agent activity page. looker_studio.md: second BI view.
  • gold_set_plan.md: the Overture/OSM match gold set. osm_fix_list.md, contribute_to_osm.md: fixing OpenStreetMap.
  • Usage: goat_analysis.md.

Run it (runbooks)

  • monthly_refresh.md: the twice-monthly refresh.
  • merge_conflicts.md: how the repo avoids PR merge conflicts (venues.json layout and merge driver, union merges, rerere).
  • working_practices.md, commands.md, token_efficiency.md: build and ship practices, every make target, and the hooks that keep sessions cheap (moved out of CLAUDE.md).
  • cloud_routines.md: the scheduled cloud routines and their ids.
  • tournament_run_parts.md (the five parts), tournament_refresh.md (tournament steps), tournament_sources.md (source list and the table tennis/badminton pass), event_group_search.md (events, leagues, groups per state).
  • refresh_agent.md, merge_gate_threat_model.md: the agent and its merge gate (ADR 0019). The weekly audit digest and the Dependabot config are described in the threat model and SECURITY.md (reporting a vulnerability, scope, what is in place).
  • new_region_checklist.md, fork_guide.md: new regions and forks.
  • Session notes from the automated routines only: sessions/.

Research passes and scans (dated results)

  • Venues: padel_scan.md, website_finder.md (official websites for pins with none: script first, model for the rest), public_facility_scan.md, gym_chain_scan.md, hawaii_resorts.md, beach_tennis_watch.md.
  • Mexico: mexico_metro_trial.md, mexico_apps_research.md, mexico_states_outline.md.
  • Names: sport_name_review.md.

ML and AI

  • ml.md: strategy, plan and discovery in one file.

Data files kept here

CSV and JSON files in docs/ are outputs of scripts (agent_log.csv, data_quality_trend.csv, feedback_log.csv, usage_*.csv, ml_metrics.csv, planet_scale_benchmark.json, scan results and more); the dashboard reads several of them. Do not hand-edit. Screenshots are in screenshots/, gym scan results in gym_scans/.

This page is generated from docs/README.md. It sets no cookies and requests nothing from other sites.
